name: Cá bớp and three more fish
nameVi: Cá bớp; cá chim; cá côi; cá vược
summary: Cá bớp, cá chim, cá côi, and cá vược are four more fish sold by the kilogram, each on its own line apart from cá song and cá giò.
howToEat: Order them by weight. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
where: Đường 1/4 and đường Núi Ngọc, the two seafood streets of Cát Bà town.
